description: Turn a PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint or HTML file, or a picture of text, into markdown. Also takes onlyMainContent, includeTags, excludeTags, removeBase64Images, zeroDataRetention. Free without a key, within limits; with a key, $0.50 per 1,000 pages with a text layer, $2.50 per 1,000 pages read from a picture.

anyOf.description: Objects with a type: json (prompt, schema).
